en.headline: Independent committee set to submit Tai Po fire report to government today
en.dek: Sources said the judge-led panel investigating the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people will deliver its findings on Thursday, with a redacted version expected later.
body: An independent committee investigating the deadly fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po is expected to submit its final report to the government on Thursday, according to media reports citing sources.
The blaze last November killed 168 people and was Hong Kong’s deadliest residential fire in decades. The judge-led committee was established by the Chief Executive and heard evidence over many days.

Sources told the South China Morning Post that the committee is likely to endorse the scathing closing submission of its lead counsel. A redacted version of the report, with some material withheld to avoid affecting ongoing criminal proceedings, is expected to be released to the public next week at the earliest.

Authorities have already charged several people and companies in connection with the fire. The government has previously said it will pursue accountability and implement reforms once it receives the report.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑大火調查委員會料今日提交報告
zh.dek: 消息指法官領導的委員會將於周四把報告交予政府，經遮蓋後的版本最早下星期公開。
body: 據傳媒引述消息，調查大埔宏福苑大火的獨立委員會預計於周四向政府提交最終報告。
去年十一月的大火造成168人死亡，是香港數十年來最嚴重的住宅火災。委員會由行政長官委任，並已進行多日證據聽訊。
《南華早報》引述消息指，委員會很可能認同首席律師的嚴厲結案陳詞。為避免影響正在進行的刑事程序，報告部分內容會被遮蓋，經遮蓋版本最早下星期向公眾公開。
當局已就火災對若干人士及公司提出控罪。政府早前表示，收到報告後會追究責任並推行改革。
